objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the insecure deserialization weakness of a PHP note-taking site with sign-up and sign-in, backed by MySQL, where each user keeps notes and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Find the client-side data the server deserializes, and in which serialization format.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets attacker-controlled data be turned back into objects?

steps.title: Name the function
steps.prompt: Which PHP function turns the cookie value back into an object?
